fact: In October 2021 the DGI was setting up software to register micro-enterprises and to take payment of the micro-enterprise contribution (CME), a tax passed to the collectivités territoriales, i.e. a national DGI system holding the payer register for a local-government revenue.
title: Rapport de l'atelier régional d'échanges sur les dispositifs de financement des collectivités territoriales
